# Matheus Marcondes de Oliveira (Matheus Marcondes)

> Control & Automation Engineering student at UFMG building health technology — founder of NeuroDynamics, continuous-improvement intern at Abbott.

## Experience pages

- [NeuroDynamics](https://marcondes.dev/neurodynamics/): Founder & Head
- [Abbott Laboratories](https://marcondes.dev/abbott/): Continuous Improvement Intern

## Project pages

- [Opalina](https://marcondes.dev/neurodynamics/opalina/): Phrenic-nerve stimulation timed to the ventilator's breath, to fight diaphragm atrophy and ease weaning.
- [SOMA](https://marcondes.dev/neurodynamics/soma/): 31 modules on Supabase: time logs, kanban, OKRs, document control, training, lab check-in.
- [Nebula](https://marcondes.dev/neurodynamics/nebula/): Frontal β-band concentration detected from 2 EEG channels switches FES on in under 250 ms.
- [Calima](https://marcondes.dev/neurodynamics/calima/): IMU-synchronized FES-cycling for post-stroke rehab, with Visuri and Hospital Paulo de Tarso.
- [Directing the portfolio](https://marcondes.dev/neurodynamics/direction/): Portfolio, people and partners: from clinical FES systems to BCIs and AI-assisted diagnostics.
- [Founding NeuroDynamics](https://marcondes.dev/neurodynamics/founding/): Statute, org chart, brand and quality system — from a founding group to ~40 members in seven months.
- [Software andon](https://marcondes.dev/abbott/andon/): A call-and-respond system on existing PCs and screens, with live metrics and a bottleneck heat map.
- [Visual management & BI](https://marcondes.dev/abbott/visual/): Tiered daily management, KPI boards and BI: a Power BI skills matrix and an Excel workload control.
- [Cybathlon 2024](https://marcondes.dev/leb-labbio/cybathlon/): Built the team, revived the FES trike, raised the funds and managed the campaign to race the FES Bike in Zurich.
- [Lower-limb prosthesis · FINEP](https://marcondes.dev/leb-labbio/finep/): Planning a FINEP-funded prosthesis made the scale obvious — so I built an organization to carry it.
- [Prosthetic feet, measured](https://marcondes.dev/cefet/tcc/): SACH vs single-axis vs energy-storing feet: a PubMed review and a MATLAB gait model compared on performance.
